definitions.explanation: The branching horn of a deer. Also used in traditional medicine and crafts.

examples.japanese: {立派|りっぱ}な{鹿角|ろっかく}を{持|も}つ{雄鹿|おじか}がいた。
examples.english: There was a stag with magnificent antlers.

examples.japanese: {鹿角|ろっかく}は{漢方薬|かんぽうやく}の{材料|ざいりょう}として{使|つか}われる。
examples.english: Deer antlers are used as an ingredient in traditional Chinese medicine.

examples.japanese: {奈良|なら}では{毎年|まいとし}{秋|あき}に{鹿|しか}の{鹿角|ろっかく}を{切|き}る{行事|ぎょうじ}が{行|おこな}われている。
examples.english: In Nara, a ceremony of cutting deer antlers is held every autumn.

notes:
Composed of {鹿|ろく} (deer, in on'yomi reading) and {角|かく} (horn). The reading ろっかく features gemination ({促音|そくおん}). In traditional East Asian medicine, {鹿茸|ろくじょう} (young, velvet-covered antler) is prized as a health supplement. The {鹿|しか}の{角|つの}{切|き}り (antler cutting) ceremony in Nara dates back to the Edo period.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鹿角|ろっかく}を{切|き}る — to cut antlers
- {鹿角|ろっかく}{細工|ざいく} — antler crafts; antler carving
- {鹿角|ろっかく}の{粉末|ふんまつ} — powdered antler

RELATED WORDS:
- {角|つの} — horn, antler (general, native reading)
- {鹿茸|ろくじょう} — deer velvet antler (used in medicine)
- {鹿|しか} — deer
